description: Land Acquisition - Wewathenna, Ketawala, Kandy Four Gravets D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents of the properties, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
